cases.sql: CREATE FUNCTION accepts_value(x integer) RETURNS boolean LANGUAGE plpgsql VOLATILE AS $$ BEGIN PERFORM nextval('domain_checks'); RETURN (SELECT allowed FROM permission); END $$
CREATE DOMAIN checked_integer AS integer CHECK (accepts_value(VALUE))
CREATE FUNCTION assign_checked(x integer) RETURNS integer LANGUAGE plpgsql VOLATILE AS $$ DECLARE v checked_integer; BEGIN v := x; RETURN v::integer; END $$
CREATE FUNCTION return_checked(x integer) RETURNS checked_integer LANGUAGE plpgsql VOLATILE AS $$ BEGIN RETURN x; END $$
SELECT i, assign_checked(i) AS value FROM generate_series(1, 3) t(i) ORDER BY i
SELECT i, return_checked(i) AS value FROM generate_series(1, 3) t(i) ORDER BY i
SELECT assign_checked(NULL) AS a, return_checked(NULL) AS b

CREATE FUNCTION local_defaults(x integer) RETURNS bigint LANGUAGE plpgsql VOLATILE AS $$ DECLARE total bigint := 0; BEGIN FOR i IN 1..x LOOP DECLARE v bigint DEFAULT nextval('defaults_seen'); BEGIN total := total + v; END; END LOOP; RETURN total; END $$
SELECT i, local_defaults(2) AS value FROM generate_series(1, 3) t(i) ORDER BY i
CREATE FUNCTION local_types(x smallint) RETURNS text LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $$ DECLARE v smallint := x; BEGIN RETURN pg_typeof(v)::text || ':' || COALESCE(v::text, 'null'); END $$
SELECT local_types(1::smallint) AS a, local_types(NULL::smallint) AS b

CREATE FUNCTION shadowed(x integer) RETURNS text LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $$ DECLARE v smallint := x; result text := ''; BEGIN result := pg_typeof(v)::text; DECLARE v text := 'current'; BEGIN result := result || ':' || pg_typeof(v)::text || ':' || v; END; RETURN result || ':' || v::text; END $$
SELECT i, shadowed(i) AS value FROM generate_series(1, 3) t(i) ORDER BY i

CREATE FUNCTION record_values(x smallint) RETURNS text LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $$ DECLARE r record; result text; BEGIN SELECT x AS value INTO r; result := pg_typeof(r.value)::text || ':' || COALESCE(r.value::text, 'null'); SELECT 'next'::text AS value INTO r; RETURN result || ':' || pg_typeof(r.value)::text || ':' || r.value; END $$
SELECT record_values(7::smallint) AS a, record_values(NULL::smallint) AS b

CREATE FUNCTION record_loop() RETURNS text LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $$ DECLARE r record; answer text; BEGIN FOR i IN 1..2 LOOP IF i = 1 THEN SELECT 7::smallint AS value INTO r; ELSE SELECT 'changed'::text AS value INTO r; END IF; answer := r.value::text; END LOOP; RETURN answer; END $$
CREATE FUNCTION unassigned_record() RETURNS text LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $$ DECLARE r record; BEGIN RETURN r.value::text; END $$
CREATE FUNCTION unassigned_assignment() RETURNS integer LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $$ DECLARE r record; BEGIN r.value := 1; RETURN 1; END $$

CREATE FUNCTION conditional_record(initialized boolean) RETURNS text LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $$ DECLARE r record; BEGIN IF initialized THEN SELECT 7::smallint AS value INTO r; END IF; RETURN r.value::text; END $$

CREATE FUNCTION lazy_record(initialized boolean) RETURNS text LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $$ DECLARE r record; BEGIN IF initialized THEN SELECT 8::smallint AS value INTO r; END IF; RETURN CASE WHEN initialized THEN r.value::text ELSE 'not read' END; END $$

cases.id: lazy record assignment after unread error

cases.sql: CREATE FUNCTION missing_field() RETURNS text LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $$ DECLARE r record; BEGIN SELECT 1 AS present INTO r; RETURN r.absent::text; END $$
CREATE FUNCTION null_assignment() RETURNS integer LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $$ DECLARE v integer NOT NULL := 1; BEGIN v := NULL; RETURN v; END $$
CREATE FUNCTION lazy_declaration(run boolean) RETURNS integer LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $$ BEGIN IF run THEN DECLARE v integer NOT NULL := NULL; BEGIN RETURN v; END; END IF; RETURN 7; END $$
CREATE FUNCTION caught_error() RETURNS text LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $$ BEGIN BEGIN RAISE EXCEPTION 'observed'; EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN RETURN SQLSTATE || ':' || SQLERRM; END; END $$
CREATE TYPE held_pair AS (a integer, b text)

CREATE FUNCTION retained_field() RETURNS integer LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $$ DECLARE r held_pair; BEGIN r := ROW(7, 'old')::held_pair; EXECUTE 'ALTER TYPE uqa_procedural_78a4.held_pair ADD ATTRIBUTE c integer'; RETURN r.a; END $$

cases.id: defined retained field after type change

cases.sql: CREATE FUNCTION replacement(x integer) RETURNS integer LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $$ DECLARE v integer := x; BEGIN RETURN v + 1; END $$
PREPARE selected(integer) AS SELECT replacement($1) AS value
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION replacement(x integer) RETURNS integer LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $$ DECLARE v integer := x; BEGIN RETURN v + 10; END $$
SELECT local_types(NULL::smallint) AS a, record_values(8::smallint) AS b, shadowed(9) AS c, replacement(3) AS d
